segments.he: רַבִּי חֲנִינָא בֶּן אַנְטִיגְנוֹס אוֹמֵר: כׇּל תִּינוֹקֶת וְכוּ׳. אָמַר רַב יְהוּדָה אָמַר שְׁמוּאֵל: הֲלָכָה כְּרַבִּי חֲנִינָא בֶּן אַנְטִיגְנוֹס. תָּנָא: קְטַנָּה שֶׁלֹּא מֵיאֲנָה, וְעָמְדָה וְנִשֵּׂאת, מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי יְהוּדָה בֶּן בְּתִירָה אָמְרוּ: נִישּׂוּאֶיהָ הֵן הֵן מֵיאוּנֶיהָ.
segments.en: § It was taught in the mishna: «Rabbi Ḥanina ben Antigonus says: Any girl» who is so young that she cannot keep her betrothal safe does not need to refuse. «Rav Yehuda said» that «Shmuel said: The halakha is in accordance with» the opinion of «Rabbi Ḥanina ben Antigonus.» It was «taught:» In the case of «a minor girl who did not refuse» her husband, «but who went and married» someone else, «it was said in the name of Rabbi Yehuda ben Beteira: Her» new «marriage constitutes her refusal,» as she made her state of mind known, that she does not want him, and that is sufficient.
